title: Jizan Corridor

objectives.text: Capture Radar Node Seven.
Destroy both mobile launchers.
Escort at least two relief trucks to the port.
Keep the port depot and desalination plant intact.

briefing:
Factual cutoff: 11 August 2026.

A regional escalation has interrupted radar coverage along the Jizan coastal
corridor while mobile launch systems threaten civilian navigation and port
logistics. Capture Radar Node Seven, establish layered air defense, destroy
both launchers, and escort the relief convoy into the port perimeter.

Your forward construction yard and refinery are operational. Expand the base,
establish a war factory, and replace losses as the corridor battle develops.

The background is source-dated. Force composition, routes, positions, timing,
and outcomes are fictional gameplay abstractions.
adaptation: Adapted from the original Red Alert mission for RTS AI units and project terrain.

title: Hodeidah Lifeline

objectives.text: Deliver relief supplies inland.
Move the mobile force out of the marked surveillance zone before the sweep.
Protect the evacuation convoy on its return to port.
Keep lifeline infrastructure intact.

briefing:
Factual cutoff: 11 August 2026.

Keep a coastal aid and fisheries corridor operational while fixed civilian
infrastructure and dispersed mobile forces face sustained pressure. Escort
relief supplies inland, move the mobile force out of the announced surveillance
zone, and protect the return route for the final evacuation convoy.

The playable Yemen base begins with a complete economy, ground-production
branch, radar, and airfield so the technical, mobile launcher, and Samad drone
all matter during the mission.

The background is source-dated. Force composition, routes, positions, timing,
and outcomes are fictional gameplay abstractions.
adaptation: Adapted from the original Red Alert mission for RTS AI units and project terrain.

title: Straits Shield

objectives.text: Build the land, air, technology, repair and naval production network.
Destroy all three drone uplinks.
Capture the harbor relay with an engineer.
Neutralize the five-ship surface group.

briefing:
This polished fictional construction mission demonstrates the complete Turkey
faction progression on an island strait. The player builds the land, air,
technology, repair, and naval branches, then combines drone designation,
mechanized infantry, amphibious assault, and sea-control combat.

The Orion Group, route, locations, force composition, and outcome are invented.
No real political leader or recent real attack is represented.
adaptation: Adapted from the original Red Alert mission for RTS AI units and project terrain.

title: Haitan Network

objectives.text: Deploy a network specialist at the command node.
Sail two amphibious IFVs through the sea gate and land on the eastern beach.
Destroy the enemy control node.
Protect the network relay.

briefing:
This is a fictional combined-arms exercise set on a native-generated island map.
The player restores a command network, moves amphibious IFVs through a verified
water gate, and coordinates land, air, missile, drone, and naval forces against
the fictional Obsidian Directorate.

No real attack, real operation, real leader, or real force disposition is
represented. See `docs/china-faction-research.md` for the dated sources and the
capability-to-gameplay translation boundary.
adaptation: Adapted from the original Red Alert mission for RTS AI units and project terrain.

title: Bab al-Mandab Passage

objectives.text: Build radar and a technology center.
Reconnoiter the three coastal sectors.
Neutralize the mobile launchers.
Protect four merchant vessels through the strait.

briefing:
Factual cutoff: **11 August 2026**. Sources were last checked on that date.

Bab al-Mandab is a strait between the Arabian Peninsula and the Horn of Africa
that connects the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden and Arabian Sea. The UK
Permanent Committee on Geographical Names places Bab el Mandeb at approximately
12°35′N, 43°21′E and identifies Jazīrat Mayyūn (Perim Island) inside the strait.
The U.S. Energy Information Administration describes it as a strategic energy
route and estimated that 4.2 million barrels per day of crude oil and petroleum
products transited it in the first half of 2025. UNCTAD reported that the strait
carried 8.7% of global seaborne trade volume in 2023, including substantial
container, vehicle, oil-product, and crude-oil shares. On 23 July 2026, the
International Maritime Organization again called the Red Sea a critical
international trade corridor and emphasized that seafarers are civilians.

A Saudi maritime-security post must establish a coastal picture before a
civilian merchant group enters the strait. Build through the normal economy to
a Radar Dome and Tech Center, produce an additional M1A2S or SADS, reconnoiter
three coastal sectors, neutralize mobile launchers, protect four merchant
vessels in separate lanes around the stylized Mayyun island, and keep Passage
Control open during the final escalation.

All forces, weapons, threats, routes, incidents, positions, timings, dialogue,
and outcomes are fictional gameplay abstractions. The mission does not depict
or claim a real operation.
adaptation: Adapted from the original Red Alert mission for RTS AI units and project terrain.

title: Relay Under Siege
briefing: A fictional training exercise: establish a relay and field workshop, defend your supply base through repeated attacks, then destroy the opposing command post. Use rifle teams, anti-tank specialists, mobile launchers and reconnaissance drones together. Expand the economy before the main assault. No real operation or force disposition is represented.
adaptation: An original RTS AI mission using project units, art and terrain.

objectives.text: Build a field relay and workshop.
Hold the base through four minutes of attacks.
Destroy the opposing command post.

title: Lights in the Water
briefing:
Captain Nabil Haidar, coast guard. Tonight the navigation lights along this reef coast lied. Spoofed signals steered the fishing fleet onto the reef line, and three groups of survivors are stranded on the beaches east of town.

You have a small mobile force and no base. Find all three groups. The transports can only cross the reef at high tide, eight minutes from now; escort them from the reef landing along the coast road to the town clinic. Orion Group patrols are already closing in from the north, and their columns will strike the watch post and then the town. The third group pulled someone out of the sea, a stranger nobody can explain.

If the clinic falls or your force is lost, the operation fails.
adaptation: An original RTS AI chapter on the terrain of Hodeidah Lifeline, with a new coast and new actors.

objectives.text: Find the first group of survivors at the cove.
Find the second group by the old jetty.
Find the third group on the far reef, with the stranger.
Hold on until high tide lets the transports reach the reef landing.
Escort the survivors from the reef landing to the town clinic.
Keep the town clinic standing.

title: Hold the Ferry Line
briefing:
Colonel Kemal Aydın. The port on the far side of the strait is the last ferry line out, and Orion Group wants it closed. The town is loading four ferries for the far shore.

Hold the port for twelve minutes. Orion columns will come down the north road, then the east road, then the south road; each checkpoint you keep standing buys the town time. When loading is done the ferries sail through the channel, where an Orion boat picket is waiting. Every one must reach the far shore.

If either ferry pier falls, the line is broken.
adaptation: An original RTS AI chapter on the terrain of Straits Shield, with new actors.

objectives.text: Hold until the ferries finish loading.
Get all four ferries across to the far shore.
Hold the ferry line for 12 minutes.
Keep both ferry piers standing.

title: Glass Island
briefing:
Commander Lin Haoran. The island no chart names is real, and the Obsidian Directorate watches it with sensor masts. Tonight a three-man team lands on its western beach: Tanya, a network specialist and one Red Spear.

Each mast sees a circle around it. Some sweep and sleep; watch the circle dim before you cross. Reach the core node in the east, deploy the specialist to copy the routing logs, then bring him to the boat at the north cove before first light, eight minutes from the landing. Every mast that sees you, or goes dark, sends the garrison to look.

If the island sees you too often, the boat has to leave without the logs, or Tanya or the specialist falls, the operation fails.
adaptation: An original RTS AI chapter on the terrain of Haitan Network, with a new channel and new actors.

objectives.text: Copy the routing logs: deploy the network specialist beside the core node.
Bring the specialist and the logs to the boat at the north cove before first light.
Stay out of the sensor masts' sight.
Keep Tanya and the specialist alive.

title: Black Platform
briefing:
Commander Turki Al-Zahrani. While this platform jams, no one can see the Directorate hub. Its four jammer generators sit under an Iron Curtain prototype: nothing can touch them while the curtain control room runs it.

Your boarding team lands on the south pad with Tanya, two engineers and no reinforcements. Clear the control deck, take the control room with an engineer to drop the curtain, then let Tanya place charges on every generator out on the wings. When the jamming stops, Orion will come from the docks and the sea: hold the control room until the picture comes back. Orion's relief flotilla reaches the platform nine minutes after you land; the charges must be in before then. The two deck scanners take turns; the lane down the middle is out of their sight.

If Tanya falls, the control room is destroyed, both engineers are lost before it is taken, or the relief arrives first, the operation fails.
adaptation: An original RTS AI chapter on the frame of the Bab al-Mandab Passage map, repainted as open sea with a platform.

objectives.text: Take the curtain control room with an engineer.
Place charges on all four jammer generators before the relief flotilla arrives.
Hold the control room until the picture comes back.
Keep Tanya alive.
Keep an engineer alive until the control room is taken.
Stay clear of the deck scanners.

title: Every Light On
briefing:
Colonel Badr Al-Shammari. The Directorate hub stands at the eastern end of this island, with the rebuilt Chronosphere at its heart. Three radar domes link it to every screen on the coast: destroy them first.

You are not alone tonight, but the other fronts are only voices on the radio. Commander Lin keeps the picture alive through your radar relay; lose the relay and the fog comes back. Commander Turki holds the jamming platform. Colonel Kemal is closing the northern sea lane; until he does, gunboats will come down it. Captain Nabil is clearing the mainland towns, and the final strike waits for his word: the Chronosphere cannot be taken before then.

Capture the Chronosphere with an engineer. It is shielded: it cannot be destroyed, only taken. If the construction yard falls, the operation fails.
adaptation: An original RTS AI chapter on the terrain of Straits Shield, with new actors.

objectives.text: Destroy the three radar domes to sever the Directorate link.
Capture the Chronosphere once the mainland towns are clear.
Keep the radar relay standing.

title: Sweet Water
briefing:
Colonel Arash Tavakoli. A cell of the Obsidian Directorate has seized the desalination and power plant of a port town on the salt coast and cut the town's water. Under the plant is a cache of Chronosphere coils the cell means to take away by sea.

Army water trucks are waiting at the western edge of the salt, and they are due on the road in ten minutes. The cell has blocked the salt road in three places: destroy each roadblock's gun before then, and bring the trucks through to the town cistern. Retake the plant with engineers: its pumps, and the power station that feeds the cell's coils. When the lock on the vault is cut, take the cache whole with an engineer. Nothing on the plant can be destroyed.

Raiders from the northern hills will strike the road camp. If the construction yard falls, the trucks are lost, or the road is still closed when the trucks are due, the operation fails.
adaptation: An original RTS AI chapter on the terrain of Jizan Corridor, with a new coast, salt flat and actors.

objectives.text: Clear the three roadblocks on the salt road before the water trucks are due.
Bring the water trucks through to the town cistern.
Retake the water plant: capture its pumps and its power station with engineers.
Take the coil cache in the plant vault with an engineer.

title: Ghosts on the Glass
briefing:
Lieutenant Colonel Maya Ronen. The harbour city's picture shows nine contacts closing on it, and most of them are not there. A cell of the Obsidian Directorate is painting phantoms onto every screen in the city from relay towers on the cape across the bay. It wants the city to fire first, on nothing, and to sell the picture.

Every contact is marked by a ring. Before anything fires on one, verify it: a unit of yours must come within its ring. A phantom fades and its ring turns pale; a real contact's ring turns red. Send forward observers first, and set approaching units to Return fire so they never shoot first. Then take the road round the head of the bay, destroy the three relay towers, and hold the harbour against the strike group behind the lie.

The families are in three public shelters. If the city fires on a phantom, a shelter falls, or the construction yard is lost, the operation fails.
adaptation: An original RTS AI chapter on the frame of the Bab al-Mandab Passage map, repainted as a harbour bay.

objectives.text: Fire on nothing you have not verified.
Destroy the three relay towers on the cape before first light.
Hold the harbour until the strike group turns back.
Keep the shelters standing.
Verify every contact on the picture.
